tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga

dud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā stī/ dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi thig le zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes dbang phyug snying rje'i bdud rtsi yis/ /bdag gi snying la dbugs dbyung nyer gnas mdzod/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' rig min yang*/ /dam pa'i gsung gi rjes 'brang 'dir rtsol te/ dad dang phan pa'i blo can gyis/ /bya ba 'ga' la 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de ni legs sam nyes kyang rung*/ /dam pa rnams kyis bkag pa med/ /rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga chen po rnams kyis nye bar sbyar ba de dag lag len tu 'debs dka' ba dang*/ 'di la rtsal 'don du byed pa yang nyung ba'i phyir dus mtha' 'dir gzhan la shin tu phan par ma mthong zhing*/ mkhas par mngon pa'i nga rgyal can phyis byung 'ga' zhig gis mdor bsdus su sbyar ba 'ga' zhig mthong yang lhag chad nor ba'i skyon mang pos snying po med par byas snang bas/ 'dir de dag las zlog ste nyung gsal 'khyer bde rang gzhung dang mthun cing lhag chad nor ba'i skyon dang bral bar bya'o/ /'di la bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni/ ye shes dbang phyug ma lha （《dza》+bcu ）gsum ma'am/ bsdu na lugs 'di nyid kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyis kyang rung la/ de'i rjes su ye shes dbab pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ā be sha ya ā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ yo ga ā be sha ya a/ ces pa 'bum phrag gsum mo/ /yang na oṃ ma ṇi gu ru dṛ dha tsi li tsi li hūṃ phaṭa/ sum 'bum bzlas na ltas pa tsam gyis 'bebs nus so/ / oṃ ma ta li hūṃ phaṭa/ sum 'bum bzlas na thos pa tsam gyis so/ / oṃ ma ta li tsit+ta tsa li ti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'bum gyi thag ring du gnas pa la yang ngo*/ / oṃ ba ta li ba ta li hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'bum gyis ming tsam brjod pa'i yul la yang ngo*/ / oṃ ba ta li ba ta li hūm̐ phaṭa/ sum 'bum bzlas pas/

rdo shing sogs brtan pa'i dngos po la yang ngo*/ /de nas rdzas bsags te/ ra nag gi tshe bu bzhi dang*/ lce ste yan lag lnga/ gu gul dang*/ tshil chen te sman bdun bdud rtsi'i chu dang sbyar ba la/ rdo rje ma'i sa bon mang du bzlas pa'am/ yang 'ol ma si dang*/ dha tu ra dang*/ lcags kyu lnga dang gu gul dang*/ mar nag sogs sbyar ba lce la bzhag rgyu yin te/ de ltar ye shes 'bebs pa'i rdzas rnams kyang bsgrub par bya'o/ /'dir slob ma rjes bzung ye shes 'bebs pa lta bu cig bshad kyang*/ spyi dang 'dra bar byed pa legs shing*/ sa chog kyang dkyil chog mdor bsags las spyi dang mi 'dra ba 'ga' re bshad na'ang*/ gsang ba spyi'i cho ga ltar byas na legs so/ /sta gon la jon du 'gro ba ni/ sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar gyi yo byad rnams bshams/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te rten gyi dkyil 'khor yang rang la thim gyi bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde ba chen po'i char yang du bshad pa ltar bya la/ de nas lha sta gon ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir skya thig btab lha gnas su tshom bu bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ lan bdun nas/ oṃ guṃ swā hā'i bar du sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ tshom bu la dmigs nas/ oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni hūṃ/ oṃ yo gāṃ pa ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni suṃ/ oṃ gho ri ḍā ki ni k+ṣuṃ/ oṃ be ta li ḍā ki ni yuṃ/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa li ḍā ki ni hūṃ/ oṃ sing ha ḍā ki ni / oṃ bya gh+ra ḍā ki ni*/ oṃ dza m+bhu ka ḍā ki ni / oṃ u lu ka ḍā ki ni / oṃ ḍā ki ni phuṃ/ oṃ dī pi ni preṃ/ oṃ tsū ṣi ṇi phroṃ/ oṃ kaṃ po dzaṃ phreṃ/ zhes brjod/ mdun bskyed/ oṃ hūṃ swā hās bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du yaṃ las rlung

zhes pa nas nyi ma'i gdan re re'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ye shes mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa nas / sems pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i mdog can/ byang du drag mo mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi mdog can/ nub tu ro langs mkha' 'gro ma byi ru'i mdog can/ lhor gdol pa mo mkha' 'gro ma bung bu'i mdog can zhes pa nas thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /byang shar du seng gdong ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ shar lhor stag gdong ma g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba/ lho nub tu ce spyang gdong ma g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du 'ug gdong ma g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba nas sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ shar sgor rgyal dbang ma nas/ drag tu rgod pa/ byang sgor nas gnas pa/ nub sgor nas gsol ba/ lho sgor 'phrog byed ma nas yongs su bskor ba'o/ / rang gi snying ka'i sa bon las/ 'od zer nas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur gyi bar ye shes dgug gzhug dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya'o/ / oṃ ha ho hrī swāhā sa mchod pa byin gyis brlab ba nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba rdzogs kyi bar/ sgrub thabs ltar byas nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ ye shes dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag ming rdo rje che ge mo/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / ces lan gsum mo/ / oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha zhes dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs la/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sems can sgrol byed sogs kyis bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs la/ bdag cag slob mar bcas la bsrung ba dang*/ nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis brlab pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/

ces brjod do/ /bum pa la sogs pa rdzas sta gon ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su bum pa/ shar du thig skud/ lhor rdo rje/ byang du dril bu/ nub tu bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i dung chos/ mtshams bzhi dang bum pa'i mdun ngos de sngar/ tshon rtsi lnga bzhagamatha' mchod pas bskor/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi gos zung dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ dag pa'i chu bo yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dkar mo mchog gi 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang snang gi yab la 'khyud pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dza/ oṃ shriṃ swāhā/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ kuṃ swāhā/ oṃ k+ṣuṃ swāhā/ oṃ iṃ swāhā/ oṃ gung swāhā/ ces pas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya khu tshur gnyis las 'dzub mo gnyis sbyar ba'i phyag rgya snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ zhes dam la bzhag/bzung thag nas bzung ba'am/ lag pa g.yas pas bzung ba'i rdo rje'i bum pa'i khar reg la/ sngags de nyid brgya rtsa bzla'o/ /de nas oṃ hūṃ suṃ k+ṣuṃ yuṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa dung chos la bzla/ des rdor dril dang skud pa la bsangs gtor byas la/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ brgya rtsas de rnams byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ swāhā/ brgya rtsas tshon rtsi la sogs pa byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas gtor ma bshams te/ oṃ sarba bi ma la zhes pa nas dzaḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā 'i bar dang*/ bkra shis kyi bar du mngon rtogs bzhin gtor 'bul bya'o/ /de nas slob ma sta gon ni/

slob ma khrus byas des maṇ+ḍal phul bsang chus bsangagator bya/ spro na mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa dang*/ slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas nang dbang bskur ba yang bya/ mdor bsdus su na de med kyang cho ga gang ltar yang*/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste sogs spyi dang mthun pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ / zhes sogs mngon byang las 'byung ba'i tshig gis spro ba bskyed/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ / sogs kyis bshags pa dang*/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ / sogs yi rang dang*/ sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas sogs skyabs 'gro dang*/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar sogs sems bskyed dang*/ bdag gis dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ / sogs bsngo ba rnams byas la/ slob ma ye shes dbang phyug ma dkar mo/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ gnas gsum du bdud rtsi thig le byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsi ta hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra wā kya āḥ oṃ badz+ra kā ya hoḥ zhes brjod/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga phul/ oṃ aḥdzi ta saṃ rbarta ni hūṃ zhes lan bdun bsngags pa'i so shing sbyin la/ spyi dang mthun par dor/ oṃ sarba bi ma la saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes 'khyor chu sbyin/ srung skud dang ku sha spyi dang mthun/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / ces pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ / ces pa'i bar/ rjes zlos lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzhin/ spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /theg pa chen po 'bras 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog dpal dang ldan pa 'di/ khyed rnams rnam par grol ba yi/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /mtshams med lnga'i las can yang*/ /tshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor zhugs dang dbang bskur ba/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /sbyin bdag las can rnal 'byor pas/ /byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur/

/ji bzhin lam 'di rdo rje nyon/ /mnyam par bzhag pas gtsug lag 'di'i/ /yi ge dang ni tshigs bcad tsam/ /gang dag nyan byed de dag ni/ /mtho ris longs spyaud thob 'gyur ba'am/ yang na 'khor lo bsgyur ba'o/ / zhes pa'am/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag ces sogs spyi dang mthun par brjod kyang rung*/ de nas rmi lam brtag cing ngan na srung ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de dag ni sta gon du gnas pa'i skor ro/ /de nas sngar gyi thig skud snod gtsang mar bzhag la/ bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ su ཾ k+ṣu ཾ yu ཾ hūṃ rnams yongs su gyur ba las/ thig skud re re yang lha mo dgu dgu'i bdag nyid du gyur/ huṃ huṃ huṃ zhes skud pa bsgril zhing brkyang la/ mthar thal mo kha sbyor du bzung ste/ oṃ a ā āḥ.aṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes lan mang du bzlas shing byin gyis brlab la thig gdab par bya'o/ /thig gi bya ba rdzogs pa na rdul tshon lnga po/ hūṃ suṃ k+ṣuṃ yuṃ hūṃ rnams las byung ba'i tshon sna lnga po lha mo lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ sa bon lnga po de nyid lan mang du bzlas te/ slob dpon gyis dang por rdul tshon dgye zhing*/ phyi nas slob ma rnams kyis kyang ngo*/ /thig dang tshon gyi mtshan nyid ni gzhan du 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /thig mtshon gyi bya ba spyi dang mthun par byas kyang rung mod kyi/ /gong du bshad pa nyid lugs 'di'i sgos chos su bshad pa'i phyir/ 'di kho na ltar bya'o/ / de nas rgyan dgod pa ni spyi dang 'dra ba las khyad par du shar du seng ge byang du rma bya/ nub tu ngang pa/ lhor chu srin gyis mtshan pa gnyis gnyis te rgyal mtshan brgyad dang*/ shar du rgyal dang bkra shis/ byang du dngos grub dang rdzu 'phrul/ nub tu rgyal ba dang rnam rgyal/ lhor grub pa dang 'jigs pa ste/ bum pa brgyad 'god par bshad cing*/ dngos su med na yid kyis bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor srung ba ni hūṃ zhes sngon du 'gro bas bshad nas

badz+ra ḍā ki ni āḥhaṃ oṃ hūṃ ha na ha na mā ra ya duṣ+tā na ghā ta ya ghā ta ya aḥ.aḥhūṃ hrī phaṭa/ byang nas gho ri ḍā ki ni āḥhaṃ/ oṃ hūṃ aḥphaṭa/ nub nas bai tā li ḍā ki ni ā haṃ/ oṃ hūṃ āḥphaṭa/ lho nas tsan+ḍa li ḍā ki nī a ha/ oṃ hūṃ aṃ phaṭa/ slar yang dbus su bsam nas shar nas/ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni ā hi/ oṃ hūṃ ha na sogs gong bzhin spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir stang stabs bcu bzhi bya'o/ /sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas bskor te/ oṃ hūṃ phu phaṭa/ rdo rje gur du gyur/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong dang mthe chung gnyis bsgrig te brkyang ba bskor te/ oṃ dzaṃ bha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje rwa bar gyur lag pa gnyis gan rkyal du brkyang ba rtse sprad/ sa'i gnas lngar brdabs te/ oṃ dzuṃ phaṭa/ sa 'og rim pa bdun du phug pas bgegs rnams kyis snying gar phur bus gdab cing*/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi bcings par 'gyur/ de nas dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i cho ga la gnyis las/ dang po bum pa sgrub pa ni/ bum pa bcu bzhi'am brgyad 'byor na rab ste/ lha mo bcu gsum dang las thams cad pa ste bcu bzhi dang*/ yang na bkra shis bum pa'i nub kyi rnam rgyal du gtso bum dang*/ ro langs ma'am seṅge ma la las bum 'tshol ba yin no/ /'on kyang deng sang lag len bum pa gnyis la byed pas/ spyi dang mthun par bkod la/ bsangs sbyangs/ bum pa gong bzhin bskyed nas/ oṃ tā pa te tā pa te ma hā tā pa te hūṃ swāhā/ lan bdun lha'i chu bo dal gyi 'bab par gyur/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang mthe'u chung rtse sbyar bum pa la reg tshul byed cing*/ oṃ hūṃ suṃ k+ṣuṃ yuṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas shing*/ bsdu na lha'i rnam pa bskyed pa med par sngags bzlas pa tsam kyis kyang chog mod kyi/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi lag len ltar na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma

zhes pa nas thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /byang shar dang las bum du seng gdong ma zha ེsa pa nas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur= gyi bar lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin yin no/ /de nas gzungs thag nas bzung*/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nyid ci 'grub dang*/ dam brgya'i skabs su bshad pa'i sngags sam/ lha rnams kyi 'byin sngags gang rung gi sgo nas/ 'khor gyi bzlas pa yang ci 'grub byas te/ mthar mngon rtogs bzhin mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ shrīṃ swāhā/ la sogs pas mchod/ sems can sgrol byed= sogs kyis bstod nas/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang = sogs kyis/ bzod par gsol mchod yon phul/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zhu bar gyur/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed gnyis las dang po la dkyil chog snying po mdor bsags las/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' gtso rkyang gis chog pa'i lugs yod kyang*/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor la de mi 'grig cing*/ bod du 'gyur ba'i rgyud 'di la bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag ltar/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sgom pa nyid legs pas de'i dbang ltar byas nas bshad par bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sgo nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang gnas yo byin gyis brlob pa yang bya ste/ seṅge ma'i sngags kyis bsang ba las gzhan sdom pa'i cho ga sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de rjes skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar rdzogs par bsgom/ slar yang thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs par gyur/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ bsangs sbyangs

stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du yuṃ las rlung gi= nas nyi ma'i gdan re re'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ phyogs bzhir suṃ k+ṣuṃ yuṃ hūṃ rnams las byung ba'i kha ṭāṃ ga mtshams bzhir rnams las byung ba'i lcags kyu sgor bzhir phuṃ phreṃ phroṃ phriṃ rnams las byung pa'i rang rang gi phyag rgya rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo= zhes pa nas/ yongs su bskor ba'o 'i bar lha sta gon dang bum bskyed kyi skabs bzhin no/ / oṃ badz+ra kā ya hūṃ nas rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur= gyi bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin no/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza ཿ oṃ swā hā sa bsangs/ oṃ shriṃ= sogs kyis mchod/ sems can sgrol byed= sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan bcu drug sogs kyis gnyis su med par bsre'o/ /'dir mdor bsags kyi cho ga 'gyur snga phyi gnyis la 'gyur khyad tsam ma yin par rgya dpe rang las don gtan nas mi 'dra bar shin tu khyad che bar snang bas/ spyir yid brtan dka' ba tsam yin na'ang*/ 'dir sbyar ba ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag yin pa las/ mdor bsags/ 'gos 'gyur dang phal cher mthun la/ de nyid bla med kyi dkyil chog phal cher dang yang mthun pa'i legs par yang mngon no/ /'gyur rnying las nam mkha'i lha 'bebs pa kho na las gzhan ma bshad de/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i cho ga 'ga' zhig dang 'dra rung tsam mo/ de'i rjes su mchod pa'i bya ba ni mchod pa bzang rgyas su bshams/ bsdu na sgrub thabs su byung ba'i mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba tsam gyis kyang chog la/ cung zad rgyas par byed na/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i= sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa=

sogs/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha su gan+dhe hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar= sogs/ oṃ puṣ+pe mā le hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ tsan+dan ga bur sogs/ oṃ dhū pe shwa ri hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ mar me 'od zer= sogs/ oṃ tīk+ṣa ṇā dī pe hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ kha dog dri dang = sogs/ oṃ ku ru ku ru mahā ba li hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ pa ṭa ha dang = sogs/ oṃ badz+ra shab+ta āḥhūṃ/ de nas gos zung spyi dang mthun par 'bul/ te na hūṃ te na hūṃ te na te te hūṃ= zhes pa'i skabs/ lte snying dpral ba rnams su pad skor byas la/ slar snying gar phab/ hūṃ hūṃ= zhes rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten cing sgeg pa'i tshul du bya/ de nyid thams cad kyi sngon tu 'gro ba'i/ pi waṃ tshul gyi bsgreng bas dang*/ badz+ra bī ni/ pi waṃ gi tshul dang*/ gling bu'i tshul gyis 'bud pa dang*/ badz+ra waṃ se/ gling pu'i tshul lo/ / badz+ra shang kha rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe chung rtse sbyar ba dung gi tshul khar bzhag go / sil khrol tshul gyis bsdeb pa dang*/ badz+ra dza la ha ri/ mkhar rnga brdung ba'i tshul lo/ / phyag 'tshal tshul gyis 'dud pa dang*/ /badz+ra ban+dhi dpral bar thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /rnga yab tshul gyis g.yob pa dang*/ /badz+ra tsa ma ra/ lag pa g.yas brkyang ste bskyod pa'o/ /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang*/ badz+ra dh+wa dza lag gnyis steng du bsgreng ba/ bla bre'i tshul gyis bri ba dang*/ badz+ra bi ta na rdo rje khu tshur gyi 'dzub mo brkyang bas ngos gnyis su bla re bri ba'i tshul lo/ / ba dan tshul gyis 'phyar ba dang*/ /badz+ra pa tang gi g.yon pa'i mdzub mo sgreng ba la/ g.yas pa'i gong mdzub bsgreng bas bskor ba dang*/ gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab pa dang*/ badz+ra tsha trang ga g.yon de dang 'dra ba las g.yas kyi lag mthil bkab ba'o/ / rnga zlum tshul gyis brdeb pa dang*/ badz+ra mu ra dzeṃ/ rnga steng nas brdung ba'i tshul lo/ / rdza rnga'i tshul gyis brdung ba dang*/ badz+ra pa ṭa ha/

blo gnyis nas brdung ba'i tshul lo/ / gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag bskyod/ /badz+ra ṇi ta/ gar gyi tshul bya'o/ bzhad pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum pa dang*/ badz+ra ha s+ye/ rgod pa'i tshul lo/ / sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang*/ badz+ra ba li s+ya brla g.yon pa'i steng du lag mthil kha sbub du bzhag pa dang*/ lag gnyis rna ba'i thad dkar phyar ro/ khro bo'i tshul gyis 'jigs pa dang*/ badz+ra u gra rdo rje bsdams pa sar bzhag pa'o/ / mda' 'phen tshul gyis drang ba bya/ badz+ra shā ra g.yon gyi phyogs su mda' 'phang ba'i tshul lo/ / rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /badz+ra prol+la g.yas kyi rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul lo/ / chags pa'i tshul gyis nu ma 'jib/ badz+ra oṭ+ṭa/ lag gnyis nu ma 'tshir ba'i tshul lo/ / gus pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyor/ badz+ra bhak+ta/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul lo/ /de ltar na phyag rgya nyi shu'i mchod pa'o/ /phyag rgya spyi dang mthun par bcas la/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ sgeg mo dang = zhes pa nas/ mar me ma 'i bar sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod/ de bzhin du rgyal srid sna bdun dang 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mchod par bya'o/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas ltag par dar sne 'phyang ba dang*/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes dar dpyangs dang*/ sngags de nyid dang*/ lag pa g.yon pas mgo'i gnas lngar gtugs pas cod pan dang*/ g.yas 'dzub mo brkyang ba'i rna ba mgrin pa dpung pa 'khrig ma nu ma rkang pa sogs la reg ste sngags de nyid dai rgyan cha'o/ /na bza' skon pa'i tshul dang sngags de nyid de dgos so/ /thal mo khong stong du mnyam par sbyar/ oṃ dzaṃ swāhā 'bras bu sna tshogs so/ /lag mthil g.yas pa'i steng du g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ ha ho hri hūṃ swāhā/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa kha phye la/ oṃ shrīḥhūṃ ghung dzaḥsaḥswāhā/ lcags kyu lnga sogs bza' ba sna tshogs so/ /de nas dril bu sil zhing*/

oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ghuṃ phruṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ghe ghe ghe hūṃ/ oṃ te ghu te ghu hūṃ/ mdzes pa'i rdo rje= zhes pa nas/ ho ho ho swāhā/ spro na hūṃ bde ba'i thugs gdan= sogs kyang brjod/ sems can sgrol byed= sogs kyi mthar/ bcom ldan yan lag dang 'brel bde ba chen po'i byang chub brnyes/ /sgeg dang khro dang bzhed pa'i de kho na nyid sku/ /in+d+ra nī la dang mtshungs 'bar ba mdzes pa'i lus/ /dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma khyed zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi rigs kyi chu las byung ba dag pa'i sku/ /spyan dkyus ring rab gsal zhing snying rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /'od kyi rang bzhin nor bu'i rigs las byung ba'i dri med lus/ /phyag gi khu tshur gyis ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang pad+ma'i snod/ /drag po'i char gyi rgyun dang 'dra bas sa steng tshim mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /chu las skyes bzhin de nyid dbugs kyi thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /phyag mtshan kha ṭ+waṃ gas mtshan pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dzin mdzad cing*/ /skye bo rmongs pa'i the tshom nges par sel mdzad pa'i/ /ro langs mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /las kyi rjes su byed pa'i me yi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i lus/ kha ṭ+waṃ gas mtshan pad snod kyis ni phyag gnyis mtshan/ /sha za gtum po'i tshogs kun phye mar rab tu rlog / gtum mo mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /dpal chen seṅge 'ug pa mo ni mang po hūṃ sgrogs nga ro can/ /dpal ldan stag mo rtse spyang mo yang skye ba'i rim ni gdug pa 'joms/ /zhags pa lcags kyu sdigs 'dzub dag gis bsnams pa'i phyag khyed kyi zhabs kyi pad+mar bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rab mchog 'bar byed 'jigs byed ma/

/'phrog byed ma ni rtag tu mnyam med dngos grub mang la ster/ /gdul dka' 'dul bar mdzad pa'i sems kyi bdag nyid rgyal/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+mar phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ zhes pas bstod/ oṃ shud+dha dharma hūṃ a ā āḥ.aṃ swāhā/ zhes lan mang du brjod do/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dang po slob dpon gyis dril bu dkrol zhing rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ brgya byin gdugs ni thogs pa dang*/ /tshangs pa bsil g.yab g.yob par byed/ /seṅge mdun gnas gsol ka pa/ /'phrog byed yon tan sgrog byed cing*/ /'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal gyur cig / ces shis pa brjod do/ /de nas shar du song nas hūṃ zhes rdo rje'i lta ba dang*/ rol pa'i stabs kyis 'dug nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol lo/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bras dkar me tog dkar po sogs kyi gtor ma dang*/ dri bzang gi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa me tog dkar po bkram pa mdun du bkod/ mchod pa rnams kyang bsham mo/ /de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya g.yob cing*/ oṃ ba tā li mahā ba tā li hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dza swāhā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ rgyu ba dang ni cher rgyu ba/ /yi dwags rgyu ba nyi ma zla/ /dngos grub gdong dang rgyal ba dang*/ /rta yi rgyal dang zla ba'i rgyal/ /lha mo u ma gaṅgā dang*/ /gzugs mdzes dga' ma 'dus pa dang*/ /gza' rnams kun dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /karti ka dang dpal ldan ma/ /lha mo ri bong 'dzin pa nyid/ /lhag pa dang ni lhag pa che/ /lha yi rgyal po lha min rgyal/ /puk+kā si dang spos chen mo/ /hūṃ hoḥ.ā kar+ṣa ya ār+ṣa ya/ sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūṃ phaṭa dzaḥswāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ phyag rgya snga ma las 'dzub mo gnyis 'dud de/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sa ma ya a dhi pa ti dzuṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan bdun la sogs pas phul ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta

'i bar gyis mchod mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las bcol/ sems can thams cad nad med cing*/ / zhes smon lam btab yig brgya bzod gsol sogs bya/ mchod yon 'gro phyogs su bsgreng bas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma shar phyogs su btang ngo*/ /de nas byang phyogs su song ste spyi'i bya ba sngar dang 'dra ba las/ / gtor ma spos dang me tog dri zhim dang*/ /'o ma'i kham phor sogs dang*/ /slob dpon mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang*/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog ser po bkram mo/ /oṃ rgyu ba= sogs kyi dod du/ oṃ mtha' yas dang ni nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang*/ /dung skyongs dang ni rigs ldan dang*/ /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*/ /sog ma med dang gu li ta/ / dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*/ gzugs chen 'od bzang lto 'phye che/ /smig sgyu dang ni smig sgyu che/ /oṃ ā gats+tsha a gats+tsha mahā nā ga a dhī pa ti sarba bhur+bhu wa phuṃ phaṭa swāhā/ g.yon gyi mthe bo'i steng du g.yas kyi lag mthil bzhag ste/ sor mo rnams gdengs ka ltar byas/ oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li phruṃ phreṃ phuḥswāhā/ lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs pas mchod pa man chad sngar dang 'dra ba las/ gtor ma byang phyogs su gtang ngo*/ /de bzhin du nub phyogs su yang bya ba spyi rnams sngar dang 'dra ba las/ zlum po'i 'dug stangs dang*/ /gtor ma zho dang sbrang rtsi dang*/ /ske tshe'i snum mkhur gyis brgyan pa dang*/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog dkar po bkram pa'o/ / oṃ nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang*/ / rgyal bzang dga' byed phur bu dang*/ /phur bu che dang pad+ma'i gtsug

/dung gi gtsug phud gar dang ni/ /gar chen 'bigs par byed pa dang*/ /gcod par byed dang bgang bar byed/ /nor bu nor min shin tu nor/ gzugs bzang rol pa rol chen po/ /rgod dang 'tshe dang rnam par bskyod/ /dpal bzang dang ni gzugs mdzes rnams/ /bde ba chen po'i bka' 'di yis/ /gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo 'dir sbyon/ /hūṃ ā pa da ra ā pa da ra/ /oṃ pa ta li pa ta li bhak+ṣa pa ya yo gi ni ma ta hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcings shing sbyar nas snying khar bzhag oṃ dha na a dhi pa ta ye pa ta ye phuṃ swāhā/ lan bdun gyis phul/ rjes gong dang 'dra ba las gtor ma nub phyogs su btang ngo*/ /de nas lho phyogs su tsan dan dmar po dang*/ khrag gi maṇ+ḍal gru gsum la/ me tog dmar po dang sngon po sogs bkram/ gtor ma sha khrag sgog gtsong 'khur ba snum 'khur sogs kyis brgyan/ khrag gi mchod yon dang bcas pa bsham/ slob dpon gyis rkang pa lan gsum du spos pas gru gsum gyi rnam par byas/ de'i dbus su rdo rje'i rkang stabs sngon du 'gro bas/ g.yas brkyang gi gnas la/ oṃ shing gcig= zhes pa nas thams cad 'dir byon cig oṃ ka ka ta sogs/ 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo 'dud te/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa dzaḥphaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis phul/ rjes sngags dang 'dra ba las/ gtor ma lho phyogs su gtang ngo*/ /'di dag la spro zhing nus na/ shar gyi gtor ma btang nas/ shar dang de'i phyogs bral gyi bgegs rnams bskrad cing tshams rngam rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du 'ongs nas/ nye reg byas/ phyag btsal/ rdo rje'i glu blang*/ yang gong bzhin/ shis pa brjod nas byang phyogs su song nas gtor ma sbyin pa sogs thams cad la des rigs 'dre bar bya/ de tsam mi lcogs na/ shar phyogs kyi gtor ma btang nas byang du 'gro ba sogs/

g.yon skor gyis song nas/ lho phyogs kyi gtor ma btang grub mtshams/ phyogs bzhi'i bgegs bskrad cing tsham rngam byas nas nang du 'ong*/ nye reg la sogs pa ma byas kyang chog la/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i dbang du byas pa la/ shar byang nub gsum gyi gtor chog bor kyang rung*/ ma rgyud spyi'i cho ga phyogs bzhi gtor chog zhor la shes pa'i dgos pa yod pas des byed do/ / de nas skabs 'dir 'grub na sbyin sreg dang*/ chu'i mchod sbyin rgyas pas mnyes par bya la/ long med pa'am mi nus na/ lag mthil g.yas par nyi ma'i= zhes pa nas/ bsrubs pa'i rgya mtshor gyur= gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /klu sgrub ār+ya de ba dang*/ /kun tu bzang po su ma ti/ /dge ba'i go cha rnam rgyal dbang*/ /mar pa chos kyi rdo rje dang*/ /mdo sde thogs med grags pa dang*/ /rgya tsha ra mo kun dga' dang*/ /gzi brjid dang ni seṅge sgra/ /sngo tsha kun mkhyen dzam gling pa/ /a mo gha pa grags rin pa/ /nam mkha' tshul khrims mkhyen rab rdze/ /chos ldan blo gros ye rdor ba/ /mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams mchod do/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/

lha bcu gsum bskyed sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la phul mgron spyi la 'bul ba yang gzhan gyi rigs 'gre/ de rjes sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i gtor chog tshogs dang bcas pa de tsam zhig nges pa bya ba las/ oṃ sarba bi ma la= zhes pa nas/ de nyid la thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ a kā ro= nas yo ga shud+dho'i sngags brjod pa'i bar du bya'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par byung*/ / bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ kun kyis dri med mthong bar shog / ces bden stobs brjod/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ / dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / zhes pa nas/ / sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /de ltar rjes su brtse ba'i phyir/ /bdag gi tshul khrims 'di bgyi'o/ / zhes sdom pa bzung*/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gis me tog dang mig dar btang*/ / sangs rgyas kun kyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /sbyor ba'i gdan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seṅge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyis brgya bskyed rtsa nyon mongs choms mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod/ / ces lan gsum/ mnyam pa nyid gsum gyi don dran bzhin pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ /oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ / lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*/ /ngag gi las ni rnam pa bzhi/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/

lus sdams las ni dam tshig srung*/ / zhes dag pa'i chos bshad/ nga rgyal dang ni khro ba dang*/ /brlang dang tshig rtsub spang bar bya/ /sdig pa'i grogs po spang bya zhing*/ / srog gcod rku ba de bzhin no/ /longs spyod kun la ma chags shing*/ /bdag nyid nges par chog shes bya/ /gar dang rol mo lta bu yi/ /phyi yi gtsug lag chags mi bya/ /lcags kyu lnga sogs dam tshig rnams/ /brnyas shing spang bar mi bya'o/ / zhes dam tshig la bkod/ / oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki ni pū dza u pas+thā nā ya/ āt+ma naṃ ni r+ya ta yā mi oṃ ā tsār+ya pū dza u pas+thā nā ya at+manāṃ nīr+yā ta yā mi/ oṃ sa ka la sa twa pa ri tra ṇā āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ de ltar shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhir phyag 'tshal ba gsum po de tshar re re bya'o/ / rang nyid shar sgor gnas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog/gsung gi rdo rjer byin gyis rlabs/ /hūṃ ni nyon mongs bsregs pa ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rjer byin gyis rlabs/ /oṃ ni ye shes 'gugs pa ste/ /sku yi rdo rjer byin gyis rlabs/ / ces brjod/ yid 'ong khyod ni su zhig yin/ / zhes dris pa la/ sdug gu skal chen bdag lags so/ /oṃ ki li ki li ma li ghur+ṇi ta/ badz+ra tsa li ta/ yuṃ yuṃ yuṃ swāhā/ zhes yol ba'i nang du gzhug go deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/

/de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ / dung gi chu la/ ha ho hrī/ lan gsum sngags pa khar 'thungs la/ de ring ye shes 'di shes pas/ /bdud rtsi 'di ni myang bar byos/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub pas/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /oṃ durga ti ā ha ra ya swāhā/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /byas na yang ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ /dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pas dam la bzhag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab du gsol/ bdag nyid ye shes dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog dkar mo phyag gnyis pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ snying chu shing gi me tog kha bye ba lta bu'i dbus su/ rlung gi sa bon yuṃ yigaphyogs bzhir yu yig bzhis bskor ba/ dbus kyi yuṃ yig gi steng du hūṃ sngon po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yang yuṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi rkang 'og gi rlung drag tu g.yos pas bar snang la ye re re bteg de'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i rlung gi sa bon lnga las rlung g.yos/ hūṃ yig bskul bas/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer sna lnga mchog tu 'bar bas/ rang lus gang*/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes dbang phyug mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ a khaṃ la le hūṃ aḥ 'gyur rnying gi dpe 'ga' zhig las/

oṃ le le le hūṃ a/ zhes pa'ang yod ces pa dang*/ gong du bshad pa'i dbab pa'i sngags de dag las ci ltar rigs par brjod cing*/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi don du de tsam gyis ma phebs na/ slob ma seṅge mo'i gzugs su gsal pa'am/ snying gar rdo rje'i rtse mor hūṃ/ mtha' rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba'i yuṃ yig gis bskor ba/ gzhan sngar bzhin las/ hūṃ zhes ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags bsnyen pa gang song des sngags pa'i me tog dang chus bsnun/ oṃ ra ma ra ma ho ho ho a a a phaṭa/ ces zlos shing rol mo dang bcas pas/ gong du bshad pa'i bdug spos kyis bdug dam rdzas lce la bzhag pa/ tiṣ+ṭha yo ga mahā kro dha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa brtan byed kyi sngags su bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed do/ /slar yang*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya/ pra ti ba ti ta hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho swāhā/ zhes pa ni ye shes pa gshegs pa'i sngags so/ /nam mkha'i kha dog brtag na skabs 'dir yin yang*/ rang gzhung nas gsal bar ma bshad pas med kyang chog go / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya ma nu pā la ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥhoḥhoḥswāhā/ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ pra gṛh+na ti twaṃ i maṃ sa twa mahā ba la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong ba yang*/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūṃ a swāhā/ gdong g.yogs dkrol/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyi su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/ sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ / zhes lta bar bskul/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal pra be sho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal dar+shi to3haṃ/ oṃ gu h+ya maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal a bhi ṣi ka to3haṃ/ sa ma ya ho sa ma ya ho/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du gsal bar 'gyur/

ces brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur la skabs 'dir lha ngo bstan no/ /ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gnas rnams su reg cing spyi bor k+ṣuṃ nas/ gyi bar/ gnas brgyad du bsrung bar bya/ de rnams kyi 'jug pa'i cho ga yin cing*/ dkyil chog dngos bstan dang 'dra min cung zad yod pa ni/ dkyil chog rgyud rgyas pa la brten pa yin no zhes 'dod la dkyil 'khor 'di bsdus rgyud kyi yin cing*/ gsang gdan dang por 'jug pa'i cho ga gsal bar bstan pa nyid dbang btsan par byas te bshad pa yin la/ bla ma gong ma ches mkhas pa 'ga' zhig kyang 'di ltar bzhed do/ /de nas dngos bzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ring bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor mchog rab ste/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor rgyal po bskyed/ /bdag gis rnam shes 'pho ba shes/ /'di ni slob ma'i don de nyid/ /rgyal po nyid kyis dbang bskur stsol/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs bcas pa'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i go 'phangs las/ /phyir mi ldog par bdag 'gyur ba'i/ /rig pa gang yin deng bdag stsol/ oṃ sogs kyis bsang chus bsangs shing yungs dkar gtor/ /slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' lha chen po rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dang bcas pas shis pa brjod par bsam te/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ / sogs dang rol mo'i sgra bya/ chu dbang gi gong skabs 'dir/ /slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus/ /mar rngaug sogs gong ma rnams ni gtor ma'i dbang bskur bar bzhed do/ /de yang rgyud las/ gnyis med gtor sbyin dbang bskur ba/ de yi chos ni bshad par bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i don du bzhed la/ 'grel pa nas gtor ma gtong ba sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje'i dbang sogs bskur ba la 'chad do/ /des na gtor dbang ni/ rgyud tshig de'i don la zhugs pa dka' yang*/

byin brlab chen po dang ldan pa dang*/ man ngag yin pa'i phyir/ byas na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur la/ ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i nyes pa med do/ / rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du mchod pa thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ de'i steng du rang nyid mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul te/ chu dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ring 'khor ba sgrol byed pa'i/ /byang chub chen por dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ āḥphuṃ pheṃ phaṭa hūṃ swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+ta 'i bar gyis mchod chu'i dbang bskur bas/ kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur te/ me long ye shes mngon du byas so/ /bdag nyid rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po/ rin po che dang*/ dril bu nas brgyan par gyur/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hri a rnams las byung ba'i/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin rigs lnga'i sku gzugs kyis mtshan pa'i dbu brgyan du gyur/ slob dpon rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam pa can/ dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul te/ cod pan gyi dbang bskur thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen cod pan dam pa ni/ /dar dpyangs ldan pas dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ hūṃ āḥswāhā/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ cod pan gyis dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur te/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du bya/ cod pan dngos su med na phyag rgyas dbang bskur te/ rdo rje sems dpa' las gung mo rtse mo ltar brkyang*/ 'dzub mo rin po che'i dbyibs ltar byas pa/ rin po che'i phyag rgya mgo bor gtugs/ spros pa la dga' na gnyis kar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/

/de nas lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya ste hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'dra bas/ oṃ badz+ra kā ya hūṃ a swāhā/ zhes spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad du reg pas/ yi ge brgyad po mthu dang ldan par byas par bsam mo/ /bdag nyid 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ /pad+ma dang = nas brgyan par gyur/ bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul/ dbang rdzas rdo rjes dbang bskur bar gyur/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nam mkha' yi/ /dbang ni khyod la ngas dbang bskur/ /oṃ shri yo gi ba ri staṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje bzung de nyid gsor la snying gar gtad de/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /sems nyid rig stong gnyis su med pa ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid do/ rdo rje rnal 'byor nam mkha'i ngo bor gnas pa'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis de nyid dran par bya ste/ lte ba na rdo rje sems dpa'/ steng gi 'dab ma brgyad ni byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ rwa lnga ni rgyal ba rigs lnga 'og gi 'dab ma brgyad ni lha mo brgyad/ rwa lnga ni mkha' 'gro ma lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ ar+gha ཾ sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur pas/ yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur nas/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang nas rgyan par gyur/ bla ma don grub pa'i rnam pa can dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul te dril bu'i dbang bskur bar gyur/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /badz+ra*/ n+ḍa a/ dril bu bzung ci rigs par dkrol la/ dku g.yon par bsten/

srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dgango bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yi/ /dngos po mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /ngag grag stong gnyis su med pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi ngo bor gnas pa'o/ /dril bu ye shes dbang phyug ma'i ngo bor gnas pa'i bum pa dang zhal gyi gnas su shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma/ steng gi 'dab ma zhes pa= nas/ lha mo brgyad kyi bdag nyid du gyur/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod rdo rje dril bu 'khyud rgya dang*/ g.yon du 'gying ba'i tshul byas la/ bdag nyid ye shes dbang phyug ma la rnal 'byor nam mkha'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpas 'khyud par gyur/ 'dir 'khyud tshul go bzlog pas bsgoms kyang rung ngo*/ / gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor gyis/ /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rnal 'byor gyis/ /dpa' bo'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod de phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur ba yin la/ dril bu dang de gnyis bsdoms pa ni bdag po'i dbang ste/ bdag po'i dbang thob pas sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur te/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes mngon du byas/ me tog 'thor zhing*/

bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la mgo bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ rang gi mgrin par zla ba la aṃ/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas ā li kā li'i phreng ba byung ste/ mgrin pa'i aṃ yig la thim/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa swāhā/ lan gsum me tog spyi bor bzhag te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ / sngags kyi dbang ngo*/ / bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang = nas brgyan par gyur/ bla ma rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pa can dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul/ ming gi dbang bskur bar gyur/ rdor dril spyi bor bzung nas/ he shrī yo gāṃ ba ri s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ nā maḥ a bhi ṣe ka ta/ sngags kyi gsang mtshan rnying pa yid la dran par bya zhing*/ slob ma gsar pa la dbang bskur ba yin na/ skyes pa la rnal 'byor nam mkha' dang*/ bud med la ye shes dbang phyug mar gdags te/ / dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /dpal ye shes dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs ma'o/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ ming gi dbang bskur bas gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag ste/ chos dbyings shin tu dri ma med pa mngon du gyur/ oṃ ha ho hri/ zhes pas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ oṃ shri swāhā= nas gung swāhā 'i bar lan bzhis/ phyogs bzhi'i sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la mchod par mos shing*/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes re re'i mthar yang gsol ba gdab bo/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i dus ni dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyogs bzhir gom pa brgyad brgyad dor nas/ slob dpon gyi rjes su zlos pa'i tshul gyis/ mchod pa dang gsol gdab de rnams byed pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes su gnang ngo*/

/bar 'dir rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang logs su bskur ba'i lugs yod de/ de'i lugs ltar na spyi dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang gong du dam tshig gsum sbyin pa spangs pas so/ /de ltar mod kyi mdor bsags pa la sogs pa'i lugs 'di la ni/ bum dbang spyi la rdo rje slob dpon du 'jog pa'i lugs yin pas/ 'di logs su mi dgos so/ / des na de'i rjes su mtha' brten dang po rdo rje brtul zhugs ni/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid yid la dran tsam byas te/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na 'dug khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i brtul zhugs brtan/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa mā ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ha ha ha ho/ / de nas gnyis pa rjes gnang ni/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs kun/ / ces pa la sogs pa sgeg sogs brgyad kyi tshigs bcad brjod pa ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sogs dang 'dra'o/ /mdor bsags dang*/ nag po spyod pa'i gzhung gi dpe phal cher na/ lha mo drug las med pa la/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i phreng ba 'phang*/ /zhes pas sgeg phreng me tog ma gsum gcig tu bsdoms so zhes 'ga' zhig 'chad kyang*/ rgya dpe ma dag pa'i skyon yin par mngon no/ / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ / 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hri/ ces mig thur dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ / gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ / ces me long dang*/

/ sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ / zhes 'khor lo dang*/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ zhes dung gtad par bya'o/ /de nas gsum pa lung bstan pa ni/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sid+dhi sa ma ya bhur+bhu wa swāḥ zhes brjod/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum mnyam par sbyar ba'i skur gyur/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rang gi thugs kar sangs rgyas lnga'i ngo bo/ oṃ hūṃ a swāhā/ zhes pa'i yi ge sdig pa'i gnyen po dpa' bo 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas rang rang gi sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ snying ga'i yig 'bru lnga la thim pas/ rgyud byin gyis brlab shing*/ ye shes brtan par gyur/ lha bcu gsum gyi sngags lan gsum gsum brjod/ rang gi spyi bor k+ṣuṃ zhes sogs yi ge brgyad/ bkod de bsrung ba'o/ / de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du slob dpon gyi dbang bskur pa thob pas/ ye shes bskyed pa'i rim par bsgom pa/ rnam shes las tshogs dang 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub pa la dbang ba yin no/ / 'dir bla ma gong ma rngog rnams ni/ lung ston yan chad la slob dpon gyi dbang zhes gsung la/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab/ slob ma me tog phog pa'i lhar bskyed/ chu dbang sngon du 'gro bas/

rig pa gtad pa la sngags kyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ gtso mo'am lha tshogs rnams kyi dam tshig phyag rgya/ slob dpon gyi rjes su zlos pa'i tshul gyi slob ma rnams phyag rgya 'char gzhug pa ni/ phyag rgya'i dbang ste/ 'di la slob ma'i dbang bskur zhes gsung ngo*/ /tshul 'di slob dpon gyi ni dbang bskur nas/ / rnam shes ye shes brtan par bya/ / zhes dkyil chog las gsungs pa'i rnam shes ye shes zhes pa'i don du dgongs par snang la/ de'i don gyi phyogs gcig la zhugs pa'ang yin mod kyi/ nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin pas 'dir ma bris so/ / yang gzhung las/ sbyor ba y-i ni dbang bskur nas/ /gsang ba thams cad mngon par brjod/ / ces pa la thabs kyi dbang bskur gsang dbang dang*/ shes rab kyi dbang bskur gsum pa ste/ de gnyis bsdoms pa ni sbyor ba'i dbang ngo*/ /dbang gong ma 'di gnyis la bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil 'khor 'char ba dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang me tog dor ba la sogs pa bzhed do/ /de dag 'grub na'ang byin rlabs che ba'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba yin mod kyi/ lag len bsdu ba'i tshe ma 'grub kyang mi 'gal te/ de 'dra de 'di'i sgos kyi khyad chos kyang ma yin la/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung phal cher las kyang mi 'byung bas so/ /'dir ni nyung ngu la mos pa dag la cho ga zor yang bar brjod par bya ste/ / kun rtog thams cad rnams spangs pas/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /ye shes sku khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyod mthu yis/ /de nyid bla med shes par 'tshal/ /rdo rje dbang bskur kun mkhyen gyis/ /bka' drin de ring bdag la gsol/ /bcom ldan khyod zhabs pad+ma ni/ /spangs nas gzhan na skyabs ma mchis/ /de bas 'khor ba spang ba'i phyir/ /mgon pos bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ / ces lan gsum/ ā khaṃ wīr hūṃ gis mig dar bcings/

oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsi gtor/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug dbyer ma mchis pa de nyid/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ / yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyi/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'di ni de nyid bla na med/ /gnyis med ye shes brjod mi nus/ /chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /dam pa'i bde ba yang dag myang*/ /a ho mahā su khaṃ/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bsal/ de ltar na lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob pas/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i rnal 'byor rang lus thabs ldan gyi gsang ba rnams bsgom pa la dbang ngo*/ khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i chu dang bcas/ lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ dam tshig 'di ni bla na med/ /bzang po khyod kyis skyang bar bya/ / zhes dam tshig bsgrag go /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ /sangs rgyas kun la gsang ba che/ /ji ltar dpal ldan thugs rdo rjes/ /rdo rje chos ni bstan pa ltar/ / mgon pos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ / lan gsum/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi gtor/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma gtad/ gnyis med sbyor ba de nyid ni/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /so sor de nyid kyis bzung ba/ /rdo rje de nyid bdag nyid de/

/dril bu chos kyi gzungs ma'o/ phyag rgya kha sbyor tshul gyis ni/ /de la thabs ni thim par 'gyur/ /thabs rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ rig ma ye shes dbang phyug mar gyur/ yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis nas byang chub kyi sems 'ongs pa/ thabs shes kyi sna rtser byon pa dang rang gnas su gshegs pa'i rim pas/ lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog gi dga' ba'i rim pa rdzogs te lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gdong g.yogs bsal/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa gzhan lus thabs ldan gyi gsang ba zab mo sgom pa la dbang ngo*/ / bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing*/ /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag bu khyod ni ma yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ / zhes dam tshig bsgrags/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ don dam smra ba'i seṅge= sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rtag par chos kyi dbyings nyid kyi/ /go 'phang mi g.yo rgyun du gnas/ /rtag tu phra phyir gos med pas/ /ye shes la ni rnam shes thim/ /rnam shes ye shes nyid gyur na/ / byang chub rim pa mthong bar gyur/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa rtog pa'i dri mas ma gos shing*/ rtag pa dang bral ba'i ye shes de nyid rang bzhin bde ba chen po ste/ bzhi pa'i ye shes so/ /don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ mchog gi go 'phang so sor rang gi rig pa mngon du byas/ de yang dkyil chog las gsang chen de dag thams cad kyi/ /dbang bskur ba ni go 'phang mchog / ces pas dbang bzhi pa bstan no/ /de'i rjes su dam tshig gam spyod pa la gdams pa ni/

chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa ste/ /de yi dngos po'i rang bzhin nyid/ /dngos po rang bzhin med pa ru/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim pa bstan/ /bzod pa'i chos ni sngon 'gro bas/ /sems can rnams kyi gzir mi bya/ tshig rtsub kyal pa mi smra zhing*/ /sems can rnams ni sun mi dbyung*/ /tshul khrims sdom pa bsrung bya zhing*/ /skye bo rnams la brtse mi bya/ /bdag nyid shi bar gyur kyang bla/ /sems can srog gcod de lta min/ /rab 'bar me dang mtshungs pas na/ /gzhan gyi nor la reg mi bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus bsrung zhing*/ / phan tshun dbye ba'i las mi bya/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de la brdzun ni yod ma yin/ /spyod pa bag yod bcas pa dang*/ /bza' dang longs spyod bag yod bya/ /dga' bar rol pa bag yod cing*/ /gtor sogs cho ga'ang bag yod la/ /rnal 'byor ba ni 'grub 'dod pas/ /sems can bsten na 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig thams cad shes pa yi/ /slob ma sems dga'i las rnams bya/ /mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed nas su/ /thams cad mnyam nyid lta bar bya/ /rtag tu mnyam pa'i spyod pa bya/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor bsam gtan gus/ bslab pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas/ /dkyil 'khor gtor ma la sogs pa/ / sems can don gyi tshul khrims rnams/ /bu yi srog bzhin bskyang bar bya/ / ces so/ /de nas gtso bos ji ltar= sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te/ sogs dang*/ gzhan yang smon lam mang du gdab par bya'o/ /slar yang sbyin bsreg la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mnyes par bya ste/ bdag nyid 'jug pa'i rim pa'o/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bya ba ni/ bdag 'jug nyid kyis rigs 'gre zhing*/ khyad par phra mo yod pa rnams kyang*/ zhor byung la bstan zin te/ lag len ni mthong brgyud pa las shes par bya'o/ /de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa kha gsos ba'am/ gsar bar bshams te sgrub thabs bzhin byin gyis brlab nas/

oṃ pra tīts+tsha a r+ghaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ su gan+dhe sogs sngags tsam maṃ/ gong du bstan pa ltar tshigs bcad dang bcas pas kyang mchod/ nang mchod phul/ bstod thung gis bstod/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor dbyer med par mos nas/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ mgon khyod yongs su thar pa'ang khyod/ /chos ston pa'ang khyod yin te/ /snying rje'i rgyu las byung ba'i gzugs/ /gzugs bzang mthar phyin pa'ang khyod/ /kye khyod srid pa las sgrol khyod/ /rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thar pa rdo rje khyod nyid do/ / de nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyis gsungs par mos la/ oṃ ra ma ra ma ho/ hi hi hi hūṃ ho a/ oṃ ra ma ra ma ho hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho he a/ oṃ ra ma ra ma phruṃ phruṃ hūṃ/ phruṃ phroṃ a oṃ ra ma ra ma ho/ ghu ghu ghu/ gh+ra gho ā swāhā/ ces glur blangs ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral= sogs smon lam btab de nas slob ma'am yon bdag la dung chos kyi chu 'thor zhing*/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ de ring khyod ni 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho las ni rab brgal zhing*/ /rdo rje las byung rdo rje sems/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang dbang bskur bas/ /myur du sems can thams cad kyi/ /don byed pa yi sems dang ldan/ /

zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur dang ma 'brel ba'i skabs sgrub mchod tsam la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mos gsungs par bsams shing*/ dung gi chu rang la gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs dang*/ / gtso bo= sogs kyis gzod par gsol/ oṃ na maḥte hūṃ/ na maḥme hūṃ na mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā sa phyag bya/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying ga dang g.yas pas khu tshur sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs/ oṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha sogs sngags tshan gnyis kyis mgron rnams gshegs su gsol ba yin/ sgrub mchod zhag sprel la/ nyi ma snga ma rnams su gtor mgron kho na gshegs su gsol nas/ de'i rjes su rten dang rdul tshon gyi lha la brtan bzhugs bya la/ nyi ma rting ma la/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs kyis gsol gdab mgron dang dkyil 'khor pa la lhan cig tu byas nas/ sngags gnyis kyis mgron rnams gshegs/ oṃ asma tiṣ+ṭha sogs kyis dkyil 'khor ba rang gi lus la bsdu'o/ / oṃ gi li gi li di ni hūṃ dza swāhā/ zhes rdul tshon phyags te/ bum par blug nas spyan 'dren/ de'i cho ga ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /ltag gtor skyel ba'i sngar skabs 'dir bshad kyang*/ sngags sngon du grub na 'dir mi dgos la/ spyir dkyil 'khor bris pa'i shul du/ slar yang sbyin bsreg dang tshogs 'khor bya bar bshad cing*/ ras bris kyi phyogs la ni zhag sbrel gyi nyi ma snga ma rnams sngar bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ rten dang dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs lhan cig byas pas chog go /gang ltar yang mthar/ smon lam dang*/ bkra shis rgya cher bya/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer rnon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' mchog gi dbang phyug gar byed rol/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes glu blang ngo*/ /de ltar na 'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga snying po mdor bsags la gtso bor brten pa cho ga rgyas pa'i rim pa la tshig zor yang bar sbyar ba yin pas/

rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la yang cho ga 'di nyid 'don pa spos pas phal cher 'grub la/ bstod pa dang*/ lha ngo bstan pa'i tshigs bcad rgyas pa kha 'gengs dgos pa yin no/ /yang snying po mdor bsags la ma brten par/ bsdus pa'i rgyud 'di las ji tsam gsungs pa rnams gzhir bzhag nas/ lhag ma rnams gsang ba spyi'i cho ga nas kha bkang na zor yang zhing legs pa zhig kyang 'byung mod kyi/ re zhig 'dir ma bris so/ /mar rngog gong ma'i lugs kyis kyang*/ dgyes rdor sogs dang mthun rung du sbyar ba'i yi ge du ma snang ba yang nges par gyis shig zab yangs rgyud ni nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /dregs ldan blo mig khab kyi bu gar lta/ /sngon dge gang yin blo gros mthur smin pas/ /de nyid gcig las chos kun 'jal 'di mtshar/ /rgya bod gzhung mang dag las legs bshad kyi/ /snying po bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di/ /yi ger bkod pa'i dge ba gang yin de/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun la rgyas par bsngo/ /zhes dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi thig le zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o/ shu bha mastu/ gcig zhus dag/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -
